lines.arrive: The ship of Theseus. Its wood is old and rotting, and it has to be repaired, a part at a time.
lines.planks: New parts are laid out on the dock. Planks, deck boards, a mast and a sail.
lines.first: The first new parts. Still the same ship, surely.
lines.half: More than half of it is new now.
lines.all: Not one original part is left. Is it still the same ship?
lines.twist: Someone has kept every old part.
lines.rebuilt: Two ships. Which one is the ship of Theseus?
lines.new_end: You chose the ship that kept going. Not one part of it was there at the start. Is that enough?
lines.old_end: You chose the original wood. Every part that ever sailed. But was it a ship, all that time in a pile?
lines.mast: Even the mast. The old one lies on the dock.
